context.summary: Public reply to a Reddit r/HearingAids member

reader.text: My left aid drops whenever the phone is in my right trouser pocket, especially outside. Moving the phone to my shirt pocket usually helps.

draft.text: That side-switching pattern is useful evidence. If you are willing, could you repeat the walk once with the phone high on the chest and note whether the failing side changes? The result would help separate body blocking from a more general connection issue.
